etymologies.etymologyHTML: Compound of barber +‎ shop.

definitions.definition: (countable) The place of business of a barber; a store where a person (usually a male) can go to get a haircut.
(uncountable, music) A style of a cappella vocal music, sung in four-part harmony, typically by a quartet of men.
(transitive, intransitive) To perform in the barbershop musical style.
